cues.en: There is a point. Is there a point to all this? Let's
cues.zh: 这一切是有意义的。这一切到底有没有意义？我们来

cues.en: Is there a point to my act? I would say there is.
cues.zh: 我的表演有意义吗？我觉得是有的。

cues.en: The world is like a ride at an amusement park and when you choose to go on it, think it's real cause that's how powerful our minds are. And the ride goes up and down and round and round. It has thrills and chills and it's very brightly colored and it's very loud and it's fun for a while. Some people have been on the ride for a long time and they begin to question, is this real or is this just a ride? And other people have remembered and they come back to us and they say, hey, don't worry, don't be afraid ever because
cues.zh: 这世界就像游乐园里的设施，一旦你坐上去，就会以为它是真的，因为我们的心智就是这么强大。它起起落落，转了一圈又一圈。充满惊险与刺激，色彩绚丽，人声鼎沸，刚开始还挺好玩的。有些人坐得太久，开始怀疑：这是真的，还只是一场游乐项目？有些人清醒了过来，回过头对我们说：“嘿，别担心，永远别害怕，因为

cues.en: this is just a ride and we
cues.zh: 这只是一场游乐”，而我们

cues.en: We have a lot invested in this ride. Shut him up.
cues.zh: 我们在这趟旅程上投入了太多。让他闭嘴。

cues.en: Look at my furrows of worry. Look at my big bank account and my family.
cues.zh: 看看我忧愁的皱纹。看看我丰厚的银行账户和我的家人。

cues.en: But we always kill those good guys who try and tell us that. You ever notice that? And let the demons run amok.
cues.zh: 但我们总是杀掉那些试图告诉我们真相的好人。你注意到了吗？然后任由恶魔横行。

cues.en: And we can change it anytime we want. It's only a choice. No effort, no work, no job, no savings of money, a choice right now between fear and love.
cues.zh: 我们随时都能改变它。这只是一个选择。无需努力，无需工作，无需奔波，无需攒钱，就在此刻，在恐惧与爱之间做一个选择。

cues.en: The eyes of fear want you to put bigger locks on your door, buy guns, close yourself off. The eyes of love instead see all of us as one.
cues.zh: 恐惧的眼光让你在门上加装更牢固的锁，买枪，把自己封闭起来。而爱的眼光看到的是，我们所有人都是一个整体。

cues.en: Here's what we can do to change the world right now,
cues.zh: 这就是我们现在可以做的事，让世界

cues.en: Take all that money we spend on weapons and defense each year, and instead spend it feeding, clothing, educating the poor of the world, which it would many times over, not one human being excluded, and we can explore space
cues.zh: 把我们每年花在武器和国防上的钱，用来为全世界的穷人提供食物、衣物和教育，效果会好上无数倍，不让任何一个人被排除在外。这样我们就能一起探索太空
